name: Damaged Jaws of Hell

source.title: Pathfinder Society Scenario #7-06: Brastlewark at War Part 1: The Gnome Defection

disable: DC 18 Arcana check, DC 18 Crafting check, DC 18 Nature check, or DC 18 Thievery check (trained) twice, to sever the connection to the planes of fre and earth. DC 16 Crafting check or DC 16 Thievery check (trained) once, to remove the pintle connecting the limber to the horses. A creature must be adjacent to the jaws to make either check.
reset: The planar connection shuts down after 1 minute. The horses will tire and stop running after 1 minute.
routine: (three actions) On its turn each round, the horses spend one action to move 30 feet, dragging the limber carrying the jaws behind them in a randomly chosen direction. The horses will not move through other creatures. Players on the limber when it moves must attempt a DC 18 Acrobatics check check when it moves or fall of. Removing the pintle will end the random movement. The jaws use 2 actions to Spit Fire or make melee strikes against an adjacent creature.

items.name: Blades of Vengeance
items.text:
Trigger A Small or larger creature, moves within 10 feet of the jaws.

---
Effect One of the blades lashes out, making one Strike against the creature.

items.name: Spit Fire
items.text:
The jaws launch a magma ball (range 60 feet, 10-foot burst), randomly, at the largest group of creatures, not including itself, it can catch in the blast dealing 3d4 bludgeoning,3d4 fire damage. Each creature caught in the blast must attempt a DC 18 Reflex save save. The jaws cannot Spit Fire again for 1d4+1 rounds.

---
Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature takes half damage.

Failure The creature takes full damage and is knocked Prone.

Critical Failure The creature takes double damage, 1 persistent,fire damage, and is knocked prone.

text: The machine is a cylindrical device ringed in blades with a devilish eye at its center. Gnome inventors created the mechanical device, which taps into the planes of earth and fre to create powerful blasts to damage fortress walls or decimate ranks of enemies. Unfortunately, the many miles of forest have not been kind and it's malfunctioning. The damaged jaws planar connections have weakened to a mere trickle and, when activated, it lashes out in an uncontrolled frenzy. The blades encircling it begin lashing out.
